name: B2B pricing settings
description: Explains where the per-customer B2B percent comes from
title: Percent off per customer
body: Each signed-in customer gets the percent set in the "B2B discount %" field on their customer page (Customers → open a customer → B2B discount %). Empty or 0 means retail prices.
hint: To manage a group at once, build a customer segment on that field (for example: B2B discount % = 20) and bulk-edit it.
